description: List a public company's recent SEC EDGAR filings, newest first, with company metadata (name, tickers, exchanges, SIC industry code, state of incorporation, fiscal year end). Pass exactly one of `ticker` or `cik` (call sec_lookup_company first if you only have a name). Optional `form` filters to one form type, e.g. "10-K", "10-Q", "8-K", "DEF 14A". Each filing has accession_number, form, filing_date, report_date, description and a url to the primary document on sec.gov. Default 10 filings, max 50, from roughly the last year or 1,000 filings. Returns "not_found" for an unknown ticker or CIK. Paid: $0.01 USDC per successful call on Base via x402 (send the payment in request _meta "x402/payment"; an unpaid call returns the payment requirements). Failed lookups are not charged.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. "320193" or "0000320193"

name: get_sec_filings
title: Get SEC filings
